title: viola mirabilis subsp. pseudomirabilis
intro: Viola mirabilis subsp. pseudomirabilis, commonly known as the Pseudomirabilis Viola, is a subspecies of the Viola mirabilis plant, belonging to the violet family (Violaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Viola mirabilis subsp. pseudomirabilis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to promote wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to confirm their exact roles in the plant's therapeutic effects.
